first_reading.title: Second Letter to the Corinthians
first_reading.text:
[[2_Co 5,14]]Brothers and sisters: The love of Christ impels us, once we have come to the conviction that one died for all; therefore, all have died.
[[2_Co 5,15]]He indeed died for all, so that those who live might no longer live for themselves but for him who for their sake died and was raised.
[[2_Co 5,16]]Consequently, from now on we regard no one according to the flesh; even if we once knew Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no longer.
[[2_Co 5,17]]So whoever is in Christ is a new creation: the old things have passed away; behold, new things have come.
[[2_Co 5,18]]And all this is from God, who has reconciled us to himself through Christ and given us the ministry of reconciliation,
[[2_Co 5,19]]namely, God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting their trespasses against them and entrusting to us the message of reconciliation.
[[2_Co 5,20]]So we are ambassadors for Christ, as if God were appealing through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
[[2_Co 5,21]]For our sake he made him to be sin who did not know sin, so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.

psalm.title: Psalms
psalm.text:
[[Ps 103,1]]Bless the LORD, O my soul; 
and all my being, bless his holy name.
[[Ps 103,2]]Bless the LORD, O my soul, 
and forget not all his benefits.

[[Ps 103,3]]He pardons all your iniquities, 
he heals all your ills.
[[Ps 103,4]]He redeems your life from destruction, 
he crowns you with kindness and compassion.

[[Ps 103,9]]He will not always chide, 
nor does he keep his wrath forever.
[[Ps 103,10]]Not according to our sins does he deal with us, 
nor does he requite us according to our crimes.

[[Ps 103,11]]For as the heavens are high above the earth, 
so surpassing is his kindness toward those who fear him.
[[Ps 103,12]]As far as the east is from the west, 
so far has he put our transgressions from us.

gospel.title: Holy Gospel of Jesus Christ according to Saint Matthew
gospel.text:
[[Mt 5,33]]Jesus said to his disciples: "You have heard that it was said to your ancestors, 'Do not take a false oath, but make good to the Lord all that you vow.'
[[Mt 5,34]]But I say to you, do not swear at all; not by heaven, for it is God's throne;
[[Mt 5,35]]nor by the earth, for it is his footstool; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
[[Mt 5,36]]Do not swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
[[Mt 5,37]]Let your 'Yes' mean 'Yes,' and your 'No' mean 'No.' Anything more is from the evil one."
